item.title: 3 injured in head-on crash on US-460 in Southampton Co.
item.description: A head-on collision involving two sedans on US-460 near the Sussex County line resulted in three occupants being transported to the hospital, with all four lanes of traffic currently closed and a detour being set up.

item.title: Harley-Davidson dealerships in Hampton Roads to consolidate operations
item.description: Hampton Roads and Southside Harley-Davidson dealerships will be consolidating operations on March 1, 2026 under the new ownership of The Motorcycle Company, with all employees offered positions in the new organization.

item.title: Virginia House Delegate seat to be filled in March 2026 special election
item.description: A special election has been scheduled for March 17, 2026 to fill the vacancy left after the passing of delegate Barry Knight in Virginia Beach's 98th House District, with Democrat Cheryl Smith and Republican Ben Loyola having announced their intentions to run.

item.title: NNPD: 2 men killed in shooting on Bellwood Road
item.description: NEWPORT NEWS, Va. (WAVY) -- Two men died following a shooting early Friday morning on Bellwood Road, according to the Newport News Police Department. Officers responded to a report of a shooting in the 500 block of Bellwood Road at approximately 5:40 a.m. When officers arrived, they found two men suffering from life-threatening gunshot wounds. item.title: Parent arrested at Norview High School basketball game
item.description: A Norfolk man was arrested and charged with assaulting a law enforcement officer and disorderly conduct during a disturbance at a Norview High School basketball game on Feb. 13.

item.title: NPD: Man dies in crash involving pedestrian on Rogers Ave.
item.description: A man has died after a crash involving a pedestrian on Rogers Avenue Friday night, Norfolk Police said.

item.title: Virginia State Police investigating deadly I-64 motorcycle crash in Hampton
item.description: Marlo B. Tubikanec, 20, of Newport News, died at the scene of a motorcycle accident on I-64 West in Hampton after losing control of his motorcycle and being struck by another motorcycle.

item.title: 2 dead, 7 injured after Shockoe Bottom shooting in Richmond
item.description: Two people are dead and seven other people were injured after a mass shooting in Richmond's Shockoe Bottom early Saturday morning.

item.title: Emergency responders on scene after explosion at Perdue facility in Hertford County
item.description: Emergency responders are on scene after an incident at the Perdue feed facility on Perdue Road in Cofield Saturday morning, according to Hertford County Government in a release.
